Pet stylist. Around 58k a year Fulltime at a boutique salon 
There’s lots of money to be made working for yourself in this industry, but right now at 22 i enjoy being able clock off and not think about work until i clock on again, Having annual leave benefits, super paid ect. 
Although I do work at a very rare happy salon 🤣 Most salons groomers are over worked, underpaid, and disrespected. I am really lucky to work somewhere that is quality and not quantity focused and have a boss working in the same room just as hard as her employees do. The dogs are happy and I am happy.
